title: Does Pinnacle provide after-school Occupational Therapy sessions?
metaTitle: After-School Occupational Therapy Sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the flexibility of scheduling after-school Occupational Therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network, accommodating to your child's needs and your family's schedule.
html: Absolutely! At Pinnacle Blooms Network we understand that each family has unique needs and schedules. Hence, we strive to provide flexible therapy sessions, including after-school appointments. However, these are subject to the availability at the respective center and the needs of your child. We aim to accommodate your schedules as best as we can, ensuring your child receives the support they need at a comfortable and convenient time.
